## Geospatial

* [qgis-agent-harness](/docs/projects/qgis-agent-harness): A harness for evaluating GIS agent artifacts.
* [qgis-sdk](/docs/projects/qgis-sdk): A Python-first SDK and TypeScript bridge for QGIS plugins.
* [CloudCompare-conda](/docs/projects/cloudcompare-conda): Conda packaging for CloudCompare.
* [ODM-conda](/docs/projects/odm-conda): Unofficial Conda packaging for OpenDroneMap components.

## Environments

* [pixi-sandbox](/docs/projects/pixi-sandbox): Cloneable, verifiable Pixi environment packs.
* [universe](/docs/projects/universe): Tools for self-hosted software and data distribution.
* [staged-recipes-submit](/docs/projects/staged-recipes-submit): Validate Conda recipes and submit them to conda-forge.

## Testing

* [bun-test-utils](/docs/projects/bun-test-utils): Fixtures and testing utilities for Bun.
* [playtest](/docs/projects/playtest): A fixture-based testing framework for Rust.

## Agents

* [artifactspec](/docs/projects/artifactspec): An early-stage framework for agent-friendly visual artifacts.
* [skills](/docs/projects/skills): Agent Skills and a Python dispatcher.
* [PyShellForge](/docs/projects/pyshellforge): A Python DSL and compiler for shell scripts.
